newsitem.title: USA: Technology sees boost from Gemini(3).
newsitem.headline: Technology sees boost from Gemini(3).

text.p: Technology Service Group Inc said Thursday that it expected to see improvements in its margins with the release of its Gemini(3) product later this year.

In a statement accompanying first quarter earnings released today, Vincent Bisceglia, chief executive officer, said, "Pending the release of our new Gemini(3) platform later this year, market pressures on pricing have eroded margins on the product version currently being shipped.

"The release of the Gemini(3) platform later this year will increase margins significantly and position the company to offer new wire-line payphones for foreign and domestic independent payphone markets.
"These markets represent an estimated $1 billion of incremental market opportunity for TSG and have the potential of enabling us to aggressively expand our customer base and sales revenues."
Technology Service Group sells payphone systems to the regional Bell operating companies.
Today it reported earnings for the first quarter, ended June 27, of $0.02 per share, versus $0.13 per share in the year-earlier period.
